annotations.title: Check a brand: who it is, where it stands, what comes next

description: First question about one brand: how often AI mentions it and who is picked instead. Takes the brand's website (best), its name or a brd_ id, and answers in one call. For a brand Parse knows well: its share named and recommended in each of its markets, the brands named most in the market where it is strongest, and the topic it loses on. For one it knows little or nothing about: that fact, and the step that measures it. For a name several companies share: the list to put to the person, with nothing read until they pick. data.kind says which (measured, thin, unplaced, which, unseen). Free.

subject.description: the brand's website (best: it settles which company), its name, or a brd_ id
